For a set of 3 prints, aim for the combined width of all three (including gaps) to cover roughly two-thirds of the sofa or sideboard width below — this creates a balanced, intentional look rather than prints that appear to float or get lost.

2. Mark your hanging points carefully: Hold the centre print up to the wall first and mark its ideal position at eye level — roughly 145–150 cm from floor to the centre of the print is a good rule of thumb. 4. Use a spirit level: Even a small tilt is very noticeable with a set of three prints in a row. Use a spirit level or a free spirit-level app on your phone to make sure all three are perfectly aligned before you fix them to the wall.
